questions.q: In Nigeria, the government agency statutorily responsible for the registration of business names, partnerships, and incorporated companies is the...
options: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration (NAFDAC).
questions.explain: Under the Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA), the **Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)** is the sole body responsible for regulating the formation, incorporation, and registration of all businesses and companies in Nigeria.
